# chameleon_catalog_role_assignment (Data Source)

List all principal roles assigned to a catalog role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_catalog_role_assignment" "reader_bindings" {
  catalog      = "analytics"
  catalog_role = "analytics_reader"
}

output "reader_principal_roles" {
  value = data.chameleon_catalog_role_assignment.reader_bindings.principal_roles
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String)
- `catalog_role` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `principal_roles` (List of String)
